title: Fire Inspection
description: Use this service request to request a fire inspection. The estimated response time for this service request is 10 business days.

conditionalPaths.instruction: If the requestor is renting an apartment and requesting inspection for smoke detector, enter "resident states that the landlord has not provided a working smoke detector in a rental property"

observedQuestions.question: Is there a specific problem or concern?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

detailsForm.completedContactPath: Occupancy = Storage/warehouse/parking garages; concern supplied; contact = No; Details Continue reached Contact

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for a fire inspection.
actions.why: Request a fire inspection for a home, apartment, hotel, business, hospital, industrial facility, restaurant, school, construction site, warehouse, or another occupancy type. The 311 request form asks for the specific problem. For a renter requesting an apartment inspection because the landlord has not provided a working smoke detector, the 311 request form instructs residents to state that concern explicitly.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Fire Inspection"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Fire Inspection"
